content: FlTextureGL populate runs with Flutter's GL context current (header doc). Separate render contexts should share with Flutter's (gdk_window_create_gl_context or EGL share). Under libglvnd on X11, eglMakeCurrent on the GTK main thread fails with EGL_BAD_ACCESS while a GdkGLContext (GLX) is current; clear it with gdk_gl_context_clear_current first (flutter PR #193530). Historically Linux raster work shares the main thread (issue #84930).
